cs.t: Running Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-AWQ-4bit on an Olares One with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Mobile GPU (24GB GDDR7 VRAM) and an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Plenty fast for coding work and for sharing with my OpenClaw setup. Currently in the process of adding another external GPU (RTX 4090 with pipeline parallelism) via thunderbolt 5 to the Olares One box, for higher quantization, possibly 8-bit, larger context, better concurrency, more kv cache.
cs.th: Running local models is good now

cs.t: I got an Olares One system with a 24GB (consumer not 32GB) NVIDIA RTX 5090 for less than $3k at the Kickstarter price. It comes with Olares OS which for my purposes is not all that useful, I settled finally on a good Ubuntu 24.04 LTS configuration, but it was a good deal. I actually bought two.
